user.title: Connect to Klydoclock
user.description: The clock is reached over ADB on your local network. Give it a fixed IP address in your router.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Klydoclock
reconfigure.description: Change the address under which the clock is reached.

error.cannot_connect: No ADB connection to this address.
error.not_klydoclock: This device does not run the Klydoclock app.
error.no_root: The clock refused root access, so its settings cannot be read.

abort.already_configured: This clock is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This address belongs to a different clock.

show_klydo.name: Show klydo
show_klydo.description: Brings a klydo on display by stepping through the feed or the favorites with next/previous. Switches the clock to FEED or FAVORITE mode through its home menu when needed. Takes a few seconds per step.

klydo.name: Klydo
klydo.description: Name or id of the klydo, as known to the clock.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: List to navigate in. Without it, the current list is used if it holds the klydo, otherwise the feed, otherwise the favorites.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The clock to control. Only needed when more than one is set up.

set_mode.name: Set mode
set_mode.description: Switches the clock to FEED or FAVORITE mode through its home menu.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The clock to control. Only needed when more than one is set up.

show_video.name: Show video
show_video.description: Gives a klydo another video and brings it on display. The video is only uploaded when the clock holds a different file, e.g. after the app restored the original. The klydo keeps its name and colors.

video.name: Video
video.description: MP4 file inside the Home Assistant config directory, e.g. klydoclock/washer_done.mp4. Square, 1080×1080, H.264.

klydo.name: Klydo
klydo.description: Name or id of the klydo whose video is replaced.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: List to navigate in; see Show klydo.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The clock to control. Only needed when more than one is set up.
